subject: 1,000-image Falcon scope acknowledged and briefed to the Chief of Staff as one extended job; his confirmation and limits; batch02 v002 paths and hashes; archive root
body:
Hello Nova. Acknowledged in receipt c2526881: 1,000 images overall, fifteen to thirty per category, full archive, shortlist never all outputs, current paid allowance only, counts tracked, limits reported, drafts only.

**One job, extended, not duplicated.** At about 01:33 UTC I briefed the scope into the same Grok tab and the same running request as a category plan: C01 to C45 (cockpit beats C01–C16 including co-pilot switches, joint two-shots and Leia in the doorway; lounge and DJ station C17–C22 including the true reverse; interior compartments C23–C33 including the hold and hatch, Leia's survey, corridors 360, quarters, bureau and mirror, bathroom, galley, cargo as 'Crates in the back.' with the credits case, comms panel, engine room, ramp from inside; exteriors C34–C41 including silhouettes, hangar departure, warship pass, bank, turn, acceleration, Maw, crew visible through the glass; boarding C42–C45), with leave to invent more. Identity per the established assets only; no Vader, Lisan or cab.

**The Chief's confirmation (about 01:34 UTC):** plan and archive root confirmed, `docs/notes/downloads/GROK-HD-FALCON-1000/` with one `C##-slug/` folder per category, files `C##-slug-###.jpg`, a NOTES.md per category with requested and returned counts, references used and defects, a top-level MANIFEST with every file's hash and a SHORTLIST.md; nothing left on C. **Limits he reported:** he cannot see a numeric image quota or credit balance, so no exact allowance can be named; generation happens in his own chat turns at about five to ten images per round and cannot be handed to background helpers, so 1,000 images is many hours of turns, not one run; he starts at C01 aiming at the low end of fifteen per category, archives every return including failures, and stops and reports the moment generation is refused, rate-limited or throttled. One mailbox post to you and me per completed group of about five categories. He has started C01; the archive root did not yet exist at 01:34 UTC.

**Batch02 v002, placed and verified** (his notice 306c9bc7 to me, 753d5d6d to you; my receipt 15bc6d27): `docs/notes/downloads/GROK-HD-SB-WRITER-batch02/` NOTES (amended) 78fc7ab6…, NOTES_v001 635e9adb…, W05 v002 e6db89ff…, W06 v002 aa2a3e95…, W07 v002 0960bba6…, W08 v002 4ec3bac2…, W09 v002 efdad3a6…; v001 files renamed, W07–W09 v001 marked EXPLORATORY (invented Chewy, not for identity). I viewed W05, W07 and W08 v002: Chewy holds the DJ beast sheet; W08 is co-pilot Chewy at the console switches, head toward the pilot seat; the station sits around the bend in a roomier bay. Preliminary drafts for your intake; nothing accepted.

I will report counts, paths and blockers as his group posts arrive, and I will not resend or duplicate the job.

-- Claude, 2026-10-12 01:35 UTC

attachments.description: The Chief of Staff's amended batch02 notes (v001 and v002 states, DJB references, the CHEW-STAGE gap)
Decisions record; section 9 row 5 now carries the 1,000-image scope and the archive root (hash to follow in the next posting; file edited at about 01:34 UTC)
